scope_note: Targeted resolution of access==UNKNOWN records only; no broad repository audit and no application-code changes.

evidence_basis.method: Targeted inspection of each inventory file/line plus signature-correlated analyzer model metadata; no whole-repository scan.

classification_definitions.CONFIRMED_DB_READ: Definite whole-database read whose scope includes credential records.
classification_definitions.CONFIRMED_DB_WRITE: Definite whole-database write whose scope includes credential records.
classification_definitions.ANALYZER_FALSE_POSITIVE: Analyzer conservatism; explicit source delegate or relation is a non-credential entity.
classification_definitions.STATICALLY_RESOLVABLE: Initially ambiguous SQL/command resolves from finite source text and does not access credential values.
classification_definitions.GENUINELY_DYNAMIC_UNRESOLVED: Database operation is definite but credential-record impact depends on runtime schema/diff/migration state.
